NOME: Nome Consulta SQL: ADV_001 - Mostra ultima execuca
QUERY:
SELECT A.SERVICO, A.DTAULTEXECUCAO
FROM (
    SELECT CONCAT('ServProcesso', ' ', servidor) AS SERVICO, DTAEXECUCAO AS DTAULTEXECUCAO
    FROM GEP_FILA
    WHERE CODPROCESSO = 'SERVPROCESSO'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'VorticoServer' AS SERVICO, DTAEXECUCAO AS DTAULTEXECUCAO
    FROM GEP_JOBFILA
    WHERE CODIGO = 'EMAIL_SEND'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'RunImportIMP' AS SERVICO, DTAALTERACAO AS DTAULTEXECUCAO
    FROM GE_PARAMETROGLOBAL
    WHERE MODULO = 'RUNIMPORTIMP'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'Jupiter' AS SERVICO, MAX(DTAULTIMOENVIO) AS DTAULTEXECUCAO
    FROM GEP_USRSAT
    
) A;
